validation.strict_library_clippy: blocked by concurrent codegen config.rs TYPE_FILES type_complexity; reported to codegen owner

limits: No process-level speed claim: structural mutex-count and future-size evidence only. Root will measure frozen combined source.
Shared workspace changes outside these two files were neither edited nor reverted.

tower.change: Typed Tower client-streaming and bidi adapters hand their owned input directly to native outbound machinery instead of spawning a forwarding task and creating an intermediate mpsc queue.
tower.public_api: Unchanged: native Call future; input S: Stream<Item=Result<Req,Status>> + Send + static, no Sync or Unpin bound; Streaming preserves Send, Sync and Unpin when native T permits.

allocation_diagnostic.scope: Matched explicit common features in baseline and final Cargo consumer fixtures, same locks and Cargo-reported dev profiles; synchronous construction/drop of unpolled empty-input calls; current-thread Tokio, 10 warmups then1000 iterations. Timing disabled.
allocation_diagnostic.limitation: No endpoint throughput, request latency or ranking claim; requested allocation bytes are not resident memory.

first_attempt.limitation: Candidate originally included tonic-gzip via all-features while baseline did not; uncontrolled debug timing. Rechecked using matched common features and timing disabled.

regressions: Unpolled calls never poll input and drop input synchronously (baseline failed after input had already been polled twice).
Client-streaming polls input on the same Tokio task as Call.
External ready batches honor stream_buffer_size; no extra per-message allocation.
Compression request/channel/interceptor overlays and encoding limits apply to direct inputs.
Send + !Sync + !Unpin input accepted; Streaming auto traits retained.
Always-ready external batches consume Tokio cooperative budget and yield within a bounded number of polls.
Both upload shapes stop polling an always-ready 1MiB source when peer withholds credit; cancellation, deadline and early response all release the pending source.

completed_checks.focused_suite: 684 library tests, 1099 serving tests, 2 closed_upload tests, 10 tower_client tests passed; one ignored library test.
completed_checks.whitespace: git diff --check for the four owned files passed.
completed_checks.final_tower_suite: 11 Tower client integration tests passed after all production changes and bounded eventual cleanup assertion.
completed_checks.direct_input_tests: 3 external-input unit tests passed, including cooperative fairness and Send + !Sync + !Unpin input acceptance.
completed_checks.backpressure_tests: 6 cases inside one test passed: both upload shapes times cancel/deadline/early completion; 1–2 source polls while upload blocked.
completed_checks.strict_clippy: cargo clippy --locked -p pbrs-grpc --features tower --lib --test tower_client -- -D warnings passed after all changes.

caveats: Bidi keeps its existing native upload task after response headers; only the redundant Tower forwarding task is removed.
Live input streams cannot be automatically replayed by retry middleware.
Closed native-channel drain optimization is unchanged. Generic external input uses the existing cold outbound state machine.
Opaque HTTP/tonic transport adapter is separate from these typed native adapters and unchanged.

msrv.note: Native gzip is built into pbrs-grpc and has no feature switch. Tower check therefore uses --features tower. tonic-gzip is optional and declares Rust 1.88 through Tonic; it is outside the requested Rust 1.85 native library matrix.
